question:
In the data set given below, what is the difference between the Median and the Mode?

{2.1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.3, 11, 15, 17, 19.21, 27, 31, 31, 33, 16.5, 14, 10}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the data in **ascending order** to find the middle term.

The **Mode** is the most frequently occurring value, which is 31.

The **Median** for 17 terms is the 9th term, which is 14.

Required **Difference** = 31 − 14 = 17.

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Data set = {2.1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.3, 11, 15, 17, 19.21, 27, 31, 31, 33, 16.5, 14, 10}

**Formula Used:**

1. **Mode** = Value with the highest frequency.

2. **Median** (if n is odd) = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term of the sorted data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1992ca9a18d25af89690437a7f08f2e5d0116cc2d04fe349b299daaa044a332.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arrange in ascending order: 2.1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.3, 10, 11, **14**, 15, 16.5, 17, 19.21, 27, **31**, **31**, 33

⇒ Total number of observations (n) = 17

⇒ **Median** = ((17 + 1) ÷ 2)th term = 9th term

⇒ 9th term = 14

⇒ In the data set, 31 occurs twice, which is the highest frequency.

⇒ **Mode** = 31

⇒ Required Difference = |Median − Mode|

⇒ Difference = 31 − 14 = 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is: **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.

Median for Even observations

If n is even, Median = Average of (n ÷ 2)th and ((n ÷ 2) + 1)th terms.

Range of Data

Range = Maximum Value − Minimum Value. For this set, Range = 33 − 2.1 = 30.9.</p
